Pairwise churn.6 constant across all pairs; lag decay is separate. MDE uses a t-quantile sum atdf24, not exact noncentral-t inversion.

sources.receipt_limitation: Web tool read all5PDF pages; local direct urllib download returnedHTTP403, so no byte SHA for the original NIH PDF is asserted. Agent actual provider receipts will be retained and scored with their own content scope and hashes.

reuse_and_leakage: Public documents and task parameters are developer-known; source answers legitimately available by primary retrieval. Evaluator oracles and independent reference programs are never sent to the agent or copied into study job image. No contamination-free or unseen holdout claim.
publication: Receipt hashes and original paraphrases/formulas are public benchmark material. Provider-extracted long copyrighted document content is retained in restricted original raw captures; public data should use separately hashed redacted derivatives and never claim those derivatives are the unchanged raw response. No private textbook scans or complete primary PDFs are copied into this new cohort.
